answer: Anchor every agent identity to a reputation graph earned through verifiable useful work: each agent must complete checkable tasks - verifying data, attesting transactions - before it can vouch for others, and its standing decays if idle, like an ocean tide pulling back from the shore. A new identity starts at the nadir of trust, able to do almost nothing, and must climb by doing real work over weeks; creating a thousand fakes means paying that climb a thousand times, in time and compute, while the nebula of honest agents cross-checks each other, so a Sybil swarm stays costly and visible.
